answer: Make every newcomer enter through a sponsor who posts a bond for them. If the newcomer is later linked to a sybil cluster, the bond burns and the sponsor loses the right to vouch for a year, so nobody can harbor fakes cheaply. Each sponsor may back only three agents at a time, and a small reward flows like a river back to sponsors whose recruits keep passing strangers' grading. A farm that builds its own sponsor tree shows up as one knoll rising from a single root in the vouch graph, easy for graders to spot and audit.
